main_text.p: מַקָּחוֹת f. p. Venalia; Merces venales.
לָקַט Colligere. Pihel לִקֵּט idem. Pyhal לֻקַּט Colligi. Hithpahel הִתְלַקֵּט Colligere, Congregare se.
לֶקֶט m. Collectio, Spicilegium: לִקּוּט m. Pera.
לֶקֶשׁ m. Fœnum cordum sive serotinum.
מַלְקוֹשׁ m. Pluvia serotina, messem antecedens: opponitur ei יוֹרֶה Pluvia tempestiva, jactam sementem sequens in autumno.
לִשְׁכָּה f. Cubiculum, Cella: plur. לִשְׁכּוֹת.
לֶשֶׁם m. Cyanus, vel Topazius lapis.
לִשֵּׁן Pihel לוֹשֵׁן Calumniari, Linguâ detrahere. Hiphil הִלְשִׁין idem.
לָשׁוֹן c. Lingua, Sermo: plur. לְשׁוֹנוֹת.

page.notes: Vocalisation of several Hebrew words is uncertain in the damaged scan; Hebrew forms are transcribed as best read. The page edges and stains are damaged. Margins carry no notes.
